pdm.office_origin: Reference safe-collection NPC external point used as RPCore public company desk.
pdm.rpcore_cycle: Own company acquisition, separate business cash, capital/withdrawals, paid virtual stock, physical NPC delivery/keys/sale, damage/repairs, recovery with handle/model/plate checks.
pdm.scope_limits: Port collection/external display in 6.1B, staff/payroll/upgrades in 6.1C, safe cash collection in 6.1D, regular-customer installment sales in 6.1E. Default and parked-car repossession added in 6.1F. Showroom assignment/physical displays/onsite buyer added in 6.1H. Remaining staff AI, driving/combat repo variants, interior safe mechanics and other parity differences stay pending.

pdm_logistics.rpcore_cycle: Own pending paid orders, Packer/TRFlat coupling, drive each of 1-2 exact stock cars to trailer and exit/E attach, return/stopped timed receiving, durable arrival then ready stock, one-car external display.
pdm_logistics.compatibility: Old stock defaults ready; existing customer deliveries unchanged. New UI orders pending. No extra collection payment or second purchase charge.
pdm_logistics.recovery: Persist handle/model/plate of rig and exact stock cargo; occupied/moving assets wait. Confirmed arrival receives, interrupted unconfirmed orders stay paid/pending.
pdm_logistics.scope_limits: This class covers two-car port collection. No five-car TR2, manual ramps or full physical showroom. Staff, safe cash collection and regular finance are separate modules; parked-car repossession is a separate 6.1F module; driving/combat variants remain pending; rental supply is a separate 6.1G module. Phases 8/9 retained.

pdm_staff.reference_payroll: Accrual after seven employed game days; company cash pays wages; junior/senior/director hierarchy and former staff debt.
pdm_staff.rpcore_cycle: Own four-role employment, snapshot terms, active-time payroll, company-cash payments, resignation accrual with proportional wage/severance, workshop discount and highest eligible marketing bonus on completed customer sale.
pdm_staff.compatibility: Additive Pdm/Staff; absent field means no employees/upgrades/debt. No retroactive wages, no offline accrual, no changes to personal bank/vehicles/stock or logistics.
pdm_staff.intentional_differences: Own prices and 300-second gameplay payroll; bonus percentages and workshop discount are RPCore rules. No claim of identical legacy staff AI, automatic sales or weekly economy.
pdm_staff.scope_limits: Physical mechanic/cleaner services added in 6.1I; Local defensive security posts added in 6.1J; visual building modifications, automatic sales and transport ownership gates remain pending. Safe cash collection added in phase 6.1D; regular-customer finance added in phase 6.1E; parked-car repossession added in 6.1F; driving/combat variants, rental supply orders added in 6.1G; interior safe mechanics and remaining systems stay pending. Phases 8/9 retained.

pdm_safe.rpcore_cycle: Own physical NPC collection: reserve company cash, Stockade arrival, collector walks to public desk, eligible timed handover, boarding/departure, bank clearing, durable refund-or-credit recovery.
pdm_safe.wallet_checkpoint: Pdm.SafeTransfer reservation, Handed flag, then Bank + Withdrawn + close operation atomically. No revenue or reward generated.
pdm_safe.compatibility: Additive state, old cash/stock/staff preserved. Cash headroom invariant permits refund even near integer limit. Shared physical work gate. Existing direct withdrawals retained.
pdm_safe.identity: Van handle/model/unique plate; collector marker or exact remembered identity associated with authenticated van; case marker or attachment to authenticated collector.
pdm_safe.intentional_differences: Reserve funds at request instead of spending unreserved balance at completion; no forced NPC/van teleports or invulnerability; arrival timeout refunds before handover. Handed funds remain payable across interruption.
pdm_safe.scope_limits: Collection from existing company cash, not a new safe balance or interior safe/robbery/insurance simulation. Clearing follows confirmed departure, not a simulated full trip to the bank. Regular-customer installment sales added in phase 6.1E; default/parked-car repossession added in 6.1F; rental supply added in 6.1G; other variants/subsystems remain pending.

pdm_finance.rpcore_cycle: Own optional financed physical customer delivery; downpayment + remove stock + loan + sold cost atomically; snapshot interest/terms/condition; active gameplay installment credits to company cash; exact last remainder and settled history.
pdm_finance.wallet_checkpoint: Pdm.Active.Financed and Pdm.Loans. Only cash received increases Revenue; loan opening counts one sale and full stock cost. Each time/receipt checkpoint is atomic and idempotent.
pdm_finance.compatibility: Absent Loans means empty book; absent Financed means existing cash sale. Regular cash sales, stock/logistics/staff/safe and personal Transport retained. Installments preserve safe-refund cash headroom.
pdm_finance.intentional_differences: Reference finance increases outstanding amounts and randomly resolves payment/default by game-day logic. RPCore 6.1E implements amortizing regular customers with own interest/downpayment and active-time periods, no offline accrual.
pdm_finance.scope_limits: 6.1F adds deterministic per-installment risk only for new contracts and physical parked-car repossession. Old 6.1E contracts remain zero-risk. Rental supply added in 6.1G; no negotiation, early payoff or personal player loans; global refinement remains phases 8/9.

pdm_repossession.rpcore_cycle: New loan risk snapshots; stable per-contract/payment default at maturity, payments stop, reserved recovery operation, Packer/TRFlat coupling, exact collateral spawn, empty stopped assisted loading, return/timed receiving, durable stock restoration and receivable closure.
pdm_repossession.wallet_checkpoint: Pdm.Repo + loan Asset condition; return adds original-cost inventory, reverses that cost from SoldCost, marks Repossessed, adds unpaid nominal amount to FinanceWriteOff, closes Repo. No extra cash/bonus.
pdm_repossession.compatibility: Old missing DefaultPercent remains zero; regular finance API retained. New risk-enabled native sales only. Existing Pdm/Finance/Logistics/Staff/Safe JSON defaults unchanged. No personal Transport conversion.
pdm_repossession.recovery: Handle/model/plate on rig and collateral. Occupied/moving/foreign-connected assets wait. Confirmed arrival receives stock; earlier interruption leaves default open, condition saved before own cleanup.
pdm_repossession.intentional_differences: No invincibility, teleporting, arbitrary world vehicle retrieval, global cleanup or occupied loading. Own deterministic risk and stock-cost accounting; damaged cargo supports assisted winch-style attachment.
pdm_repossession.scope_limits: Normal parked-car variant only; driving borrowers, combat encounters, negotiable collections, precise ramp/winch physics, rental and other PDM systems remain subsequent work/refinement. Phases 8/9 retained.

pdm_rental_supply.rpcore_cycle: Own two matching ready-stock units reserved, Packer/TRFlat coupling and assisted loading, external airport lot, horn summons buyer, stopped timed acceptance and own cargo cleanup, return rig to PDM, atomic stock/cost/revenue/payment.
pdm_rental_supply.wallet_checkpoint: Pdm.Rental with exact stock IDs/cargo/rig handles, price snapshots and Delivered/Returned. Before acceptance cancel unlocks paid stock; after acceptance preserve payable order, normal payout after returned checkpoint.
pdm_rental_supply.recovery: Authenticate exact rig/cargo. Before acceptance return reservation to stock; accepted with healthy rig resumes return; accepted with unavailable world rig recovers payable receipt once. Cash/counter limits retain pending order; available cash withdrawal at desk after acceptance can free capacity.
pdm_rental_supply.compatibility: Absent Rental means no order. Existing Pdm/Finance/Repo/Logistics/Staff/Safe configs and personal Transport unchanged; only new config installed if absent.
pdm_rental_supply.intentional_differences: Own catalogue models/rate, always-available offers conditional on two matching paid ready stock instead of random legacy daily queue. No screen fades, disabled player controls, occupied cargo attachment, invincibility or global cleanup. Not consumer vehicle rental.
pdm_rental_supply.scope_limits: One two-car fleet supply contract at a time; no consumer rental/deposit/return cycle, random daily order queue, custom dialogue/audio, detailed ramp physics or full remaining PDM parity. Phases 8/9 retained.

pdm_showroom.rpcore_cycle: Persistent exact stock/slot/vehicle assignment, fixed collision/ground/interior checks, protected reserved temporary displays with price cards, selective recollection, own public-desk buyer/handover/sale and departure cleanup.
pdm_showroom.wallet_checkpoint: Pdm.Showroom and ShowroomSale; onsite sale credits cash/revenue/cost, removes exact stock/slot and closes intent together. No charge for assignment/removal and no free stock.
pdm_showroom.compatibility: Missing fields initialize empty. Existing cash/loans/repo/rental/staff/safe and personal Transport preserved. Delivery/repair recollect only selected displayed stock; rental supply excludes assigned stock.
pdm_showroom.recovery: Handle/model/plate authentication; nearby respawn only if old entity absent and bay free; far cleanup retains slot metadata. Interrupted unpaid buyer cancels intent and preserves inventory/assignment; paid sale cannot return to stock.
pdm_showroom.intentional_differences: No global showroom/parking generator deletion or forced doors/IPL activation. Numbered slots 9-11 use exterior checks per their lower reference level. Own explicit buyer event at public desk instead of random automatic showroom sale.
pdm_showroom.scope_limits: No preview cameras, cover-cloth system, automatic reputation/random sales, forced interior access or full building/staff upgrades. Interior/floor readiness and occupied bays can leave display pending; phases 8/9 retained.

pdm_premises.rpcore_cycle: Own hired/paid mechanic and cleaner NPCs, selected displayed-stock service request, walk/animation, timed atomic repair or cleaning, company expense only on repair completion, preserved slot/stock and interrupted-intent recovery.
pdm_premises.wallet_checkpoint: Additive Pdm.PremisesService, DirtSeconds and Stock.Dirt. Snapshot employee/price/handle; commit stock condition, expense and close intent together; no charge or partial condition change on cancellation.
pdm_premises.compatibility: Old stock defaults to zero dirt; prior contracts retain saved prices. Existing four-role staff config is cloned and cleaner offer merged in memory; no rewrite/reset of custom wages, saves or visual resources.
pdm_premises.intentional_differences: Own active-time dirt: +1 per 60 seconds to displayed units, max 15, 0.5 percent quote penalty per level. Explicit car cleaning/repair requests, not a port of legacy floor/trash chore AI. Paid cleaner salary but no per-clean fee. Reference points/models/cleaner animation guide own code; no copying source.
pdm_premises.scope_limits: Defensive guards added in 6.1J. No global relationship changes, forced interiors, arbitrary pedestrian removal, automatic floor/bin cleaning or full staff parity. Native paths/animations and interior access require GTA testing. Phases 8/9 retained.

pdm_security.rpcore_cycle: Two optional staff contracts, own NPC guard posts, paid-duty weapon state, visible local ambient attackers only, bounded engagement and walking return, recall from menu, delayed own replacement after death.
pdm_security.compatibility: No new wallet operation or automatic guard hire; existing staff payroll/checkpoints/severance reused. Old staff configuration cloned and missing offers merged in memory. No rewriting old wages, sales or stock.
pdm_security.intentional_differences: Own hire price 1300 and wage 260 per default active 300 seconds. Finite 120-round rifle, no dropped weapon, no invincibility, no arbitrary pedestrian deletion or global relationship groups. Stops on wanted/mission/cutscene/death, no police/SWAT/army/player/script-mission targets and no pursuit outside per-post radius.
pdm_security.scope_limits: Does not spawn attackers or simulate theft/insurance. Physical CCTV/own live viewer added in 6.1K; administrative safe exposure and business insurance added in 6.1L. Does not clear wanted or replace police. Combat, line of sight, safe spawn and navmesh require GTA testing. No claim of complete PDM parity; phases 8/9 retained.

pdm_surveillance.rpcore_cycle: One-time optional company purchase, three own physical CCTV props, preservation of existing equivalent map props, office-only live scripted camera viewer, feed cycling and bounded modal session with cleanup.
pdm_surveillance.wallet_checkpoint: Additive Pdm.Surveillance Purchased/Paid; company cash, existing staff UpgradeSpent and receipt committed atomically. No monthly charge, insurance payout, stock change or financial bonus.
pdm_surveillance.compatibility: Missing state means unpurchased. New configuration only; previous staff/security/showroom configs unchanged. Only owned props/camera removed. Refuses opening over another camera and does not stop another identified rendering camera on exit.
pdm_surveillance.intentional_differences: Reference camera purchase/props/preview used as static evidence. Multi-feed live viewer and framing are own additions; no claim that legacy preview was a CCTV gameplay viewer. No world prop sweep, forced player relocation, invincibility, timecycle effects or persistent control changes.
pdm_surveillance.scope_limits: No recording/playback or remote phone access. 6.1L adds explicit administrative safe exposure, insurance and contractual guard/camera risk reduction; no physical theft mission. Native render transitions, framing and interaction with other camera mods require GTA testing. Phases 8/9 retained.

pdm_risk_insurance.rpcore_cycle: Optional open/close administrative safe, consecutive active away exposure, stable per-check roll, contractual CCTV/paid-guard risk reduction, real loss and covered reimbursement atomically, safe closes after event, bounded history. Optional paid policy snapshots, active-time renewal, cancellation and lapse.
pdm_risk_insurance.wallet_checkpoint: Additive Pdm.Risk; same existing company cash, no second safe balance. Premiums, Stolen/Reimbursed totals and policy/incident/check receipt checkpoint together. Claim cannot create profit or be requested without a loss.
pdm_risk_insurance.compatibility: Old state means safe closed and no policy, with no new risk or auto-premium. Unknown fields retained. Old staff/security/surveillance/finance/stock configs unchanged; PdmRisk.json only new config.
pdm_risk_insurance.intentional_differences: Own 120-second consecutive exposure and 1800 active-second policy periods, no offline accrual. Initial premium paid immediately; stable roll instead of legacy reused random variable. Tier 5 uses displayed 80000 premium and explicit 2-million cap rather than legacy 85000 recurring fee/200-million internal cap. 30/35/35 rating drives own risk multiplier and requires guards paid, not just hired.
pdm_risk_insurance.scope_limits: Administrative open-safe risk only. No safe prop/interior animation, spawned robber, stock theft, general vehicle insurance or physical heist. No teleport, wanted manipulation or new police AI. Phases 8/9 and other PDM differences remain.

housing_eclipse.reference_wiring: No external Apartments.Instance call found in the 75-file export. Class logic is static evidence; RPCore explicitly registers its own HousingSystem in Main.
housing_eclipse.rpcore_cycle: Own F10 housing menu and safehouse map icon, physical entrance interaction, optional atomic personal-bank purchase, profile ownership snapshot, asynchronous interior/floor probe, free entry/exit and public escape for non-owner profile.
housing_eclipse.wallet_checkpoint: Additive Housing.Properties and Receipts. Purchase debits Bank and ownership together, rollback on failed save; no changes to Pdm, personal vehicles, needs or installed visual resources.
housing_eclipse.compatibility: Missing Housing means unowned. Existing saves/configs retained. Only own blip removed on dispose. Requested IPL is not globally unloaded; no forced interior entity-set changes, invincibility or persistent player control changes.
housing_eclipse.intentional_differences: Reference purchase invokes IPL loader but does not automatically enter; RPCore requires a separate entry action and verifies floor readiness. Ownership checks prevent repeat charges. Exit remains available to a profile already inside, including with wanted level unchanged.
housing_eclipse.scope_limits: Eclipse ownership and access only. No wardrobe/editor, apartment storage, rental/hotels, furniture, garage ownership or needs changes. Native IPL/floor/framing and entry/exit require GTA testing. PDM differences and phases 8/9 remain.
